title: Airport WiFi Login
scenario: Free airport WiFi asks for your email password before connecting.

answers.A: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.B: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.C: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.
answers.D: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.

explanation: Airport WiFi Login: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: WiFi access should not need your email password.
